title: Any way to use imagegen for Claude?
author: CTXBITXH
selftext:
Hello everyone,

after dabbling with Codex for a while i have now switched to Claude Opus 5.5 and i am blown away. Usage is way more generous and workflow is way more efficient.

Only thing i miss: Imagegen from Codex. Used it for my UI and some art assets, which was pretty useful. But i dont want to keep paying for GPT just to use the imagegen.

Is there a way to use some imagegen for claude? Or is there an cheap alternative? 

Ty for yall input

comments.author: Bavariasnaps
comments.body: You can use the Plus membership its onyl around 20 bucks a month and you still can generate hundreds of images every weeks, also open ai often gives free resets you can save for later. Right now Iam doing exactly that and is generating over 100 images as batch job with perfectly transparent background in exactly the style I want.

replies.author: CTXBITXH
replies.body: The problem is, for my project i currently need like 10 images per week, maybe +-5. Paying 20 bucks for that seems a bit too much for me personally, but maybe there is no other way.

replies.author: SaraSolGames
replies.body: I do it like this: I pay 8bucks per month on gpt and tell claude to use the gpt chat to make images. You can make up to 100 per day there.

replies.author: Bavariasnaps
replies.body:
nono theere a few different ways. connect hugging face connector they have free image generation budget, or cloudwalker from cloudflare.

without api you could also use chatgpt web free or google gemini. for 10 images a week thats completly fine.

replies.author: obsidianterror
replies.body: You can create an open router account and connect to an image gen api (usually 8 to 15 cents per image) then ask Claude to use this api. I think this should work for this many (few) images.

comments.author: Soul_Mate_4ever
comments.body: I use cursor ai to generate images for Claude. I find it to be faster than imagegen at generating images. I just tell my Claude to communicate with cursor via cli and that works.

comments.author: Dakroh_88
comments.body:
I’ve solved this.  My claude makes images using imagegen

\*\*1. The file:\*\* \[SKILL.md\](codex-imagegen/SKILL.md), have it build you a skill for using codex cli 

\*\*2. The message:\*\*

\> This lets Claude Code make images through your ChatGPT subscription, so you don't pay for the API. You need a ChatGPT plan that includes Codex, and Claude Code on the same Windows PC.  
\>  
\> 1. Install Codex CLI by pasting this into PowerShell, then open a new PowerShell window:  
\> \`powershell -ExecutionPolicy ByPass -c "irm https://chatgpt.com/codex/install.ps1 | iex"\`  
\>  
\> 2. Run \`codex login\` and sign in with your ChatGPT account, not an API key.  
\>  
\> 3. Run \`codex login status\`. It should say "Logged in using ChatGPT".  
\>  
\> 4. Save the skill file as \`C:\\Users\\YOUR-NAME\\.claude\\skills\\codex-imagegen\\SKILL.md\`. You'll probably need to create the \`skills\` and \`codex-imagegen\` folders yourself.  
\>  
\> 5. Start a new Claude Code session and ask it to generate an image, like "make me a red apple icon and save it to my Desktop".  
\>  
\> If Codex says image generation isn't available, run \`codex logout\`, then \`codex login\`, and try again.

I’ll need to review my skill.md before I share it if anyone wants it.
